question: Do the SNpp45 hair-plate neurons in our simulated connectome show the published CxHP8 output pattern (strongest direct input to posterior-moving coxa motor neurons, net inhibition of forward-moving coxa motor neurons), first in the front legs and then in the middle/hind serial copies?
reference: Proprioceptive limit detectors contribute to sensorimotor control of the Drosophila leg, Nature Communications 2026 (preprint PMC12139860): CxHP8 is the only hair plate entering via VProN; strongest monosynaptic input to the coxa posterior module; strongest inhibition onto the coxa promote module; predicted net excitation of posterior and inhibition of anterior movement. Reconstructed in FANC (female), not MANC.
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Annotation counts only: SNpp45 by entry nerve (VProN 12, ProLN 1, MesoLN 23, MetaLN 16) and SNpp52 (DProN 6, MesoLN 10, MetaLN 10); bodymap leg MN population names. No synapse counts between them were computed.

sources.motor_populations: bodymap.json muscles entries named '<population> T<seg> <side>' (deduplicated neurons per population and leg)

sensory_sets.T1: type SNpp45 and entryNerve VProN (CxHP8 identity in the reference); the single ProLN SNpp45 is reported, not used
sensory_sets.side: rootSide L/R, else somaSide L/R; neurons without a side are reported and excluded

motor_sets.note: The reference names FANC modules, not these populations; mapping 'posterior/promote module' to these annotated populations is a declared assumption. Promotor MNs are annotated only in T1.

metrics.edges: simulated CSR, synapse count >= 6 per edge (engine floor)
metrics.direct: total synapses from the leg's sensory set onto each same-leg, same-side MN population
metrics.net_two_hop: sum over interneurons k (any non-sensory, non-motor neuron) of syn(S->k) * sign(k) * syn(k->M), sign +1 acetylcholine, -1 GABA or glutamate, 0 otherwise; reported for posterior and anterior sets

acceptance.per_leg_match: (i) direct synapses onto the posterior set > onto the anterior set, AND (ii) the single same-leg MN population with the most direct synapses is in the posterior set, AND (iii) net_two_hop onto the anterior set < 0
acceptance.SERIAL_MATCH: per_leg_match in at least 3 of the 4 T2/T3 legs
acceptance.verdict: MATCH_ALL if both; FRONT_ONLY if CXHP8_MATCH_FRONT only; SERIAL_ONLY if SERIAL_MATCH only; NO_MATCH otherwise; INCONCLUSIVE if a source hash fails or a used leg has no sensory neurons

consequence_declared_in_advance: MATCH_ALL -> Step B encodes SNpp45 in all six legs; FRONT_ONLY -> Step B front legs only; SERIAL_ONLY or NO_MATCH -> stop and report before any encoder.
interpretation_limits: Structural connectivity only; no simulation. Our dataset is male (MaleCNS), the reference used female FANC.
Posterior/anterior population sets are a declared mapping of the reference's modules.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
